themes.label: Good service and respectful staff
themes.definition: Praise for service quality or for staff and loan officers being kind, respectful, helpful or easy to reach. Not speed of the loan process (loan_speed_positive).

themes.label: Fast, easy loan process
themes.definition: The loan is quick or easy to get: fast approval, processing and disbursement. Few documents or no guarantor goes to requirements_positive.

themes.label: Low or fair interest rates
themes.definition: Interest rates described as low, fair or better than other lenders.

themes.label: Positive impact on business, household or family
themes.definition: The loan improved income, business, assets, living standards, children's schooling or helped through an emergency or hard time.

themes.label: Flexible, manageable repayment
themes.definition: Repayment schedules are easy or flexible, or staff are understanding when a client is late or in hardship.

themes.label: Poor service or rude staff
themes.definition: Complaints about customer service or how staff treat clients: rude, disrespectful, sarcastic, impatient, unhelpful, lacking understanding, or a poor customer relationship in general. Pressure or harassment during collection goes to collection_pressure_negative.

themes.label: High interest rates
themes.definition: Interest rates described as too high, or asks to lower them. Other charges and insurance go to fees_insurance_negative.

themes.label: Slow approval or disbursement
themes.definition: Approval, processing or disbursement takes too long, or asks to speed it up. Waiting in line at the branch goes to branch_access_negative.

themes.label: Loan amount too small
themes.definition: The amount given is too small or was cut, or asks for a higher amount or limit, including at renewal.

themes.label: Pressure or harassment in collection
themes.definition: Aggressive, embarrassing or harassing behaviour when collecting repayments, repeated demands after payment, or pressure tactics.

themes.label: Wants more flexible repayment
themes.definition: Asks for longer repayment periods, grace periods, extensions in an emergency or a more lenient schedule. How staff behave when collecting goes to collection_pressure_negative.

themes.label: High fees or insurance problems
themes.definition: Charges other than interest are too high (processing, commitment, mobile money fees), or complaints about insurance cost, slow claims or exclusions.

themes.label: Too many requirements or documents
themes.definition: Too much paperwork, collateral, photos or rules, or strict eligibility that makes it hard to apply or qualify.

themes.label: Branches too far or too busy
themes.definition: Too few branches or meeting points, too far away, or long waits at the counter.

themes.label: Unclear terms, broken promises or distrust
themes.definition: Loan terms or conditions were not explained or not clear, a promised benefit did not happen, no help when seeking a new loan, or distrust of VisionFund's honesty. General poor service or a poor customer relationship goes to staff_service_negative.

themes.label: Problems with repayment channels
themes.definition: Technical or practical problems paying back, such as mobile money errors, wrong deductions or missing balance messages.

themes.label: Problems with group lending
themes.definition: Joint liability problems: other members not paying or letting the group down (for example 'some people don't pay', 'quedan mal'), or wanting an individual loan or a loan on one's own signature instead of a group loan.

themes.label: Would not refer for privacy reasons
themes.definition: Hesitant to recommend because they do not want others to know about their loan, or because people would know they have a loan.

themes.label: Asks for other product or process changes
themes.definition: Suggestions for loan terms or features not covered by another code (for example loyalty rewards, SMS balances, agricultural products).
